We also saw some recognizable faces in new places, as Ben Johnson took over as Chicago Bears head coach, Kellen Moore as New Orleans Saints HC and Brian Schottenheimer with the Dallas Cowboys . Each of them will carry the dual responsibility of coaching and calling offensive plays. Meanwhile, veteran coaches Andy Reid ( Kansas City Chiefs ), Sean Payton ( Denver Broncos ) and Sean McVay ( Los Angeles Rams ) continue to churn out creative offensive systems. And Josh McDaniels is back for his third stint as the New England Patriots ' offensive coordinator, aiming to push second-year quarterback Drake Maye to another level.
